ADVANCED ALL-WHEEL DRIVE // Charger doesn’t hide out in the garage just because Mother Nature
is in a mood. Available All-Wheel Drive (AWD) delivers prompt control when and where it’s needed.
The advanced automatic Active AWD System intuitively and seamlessly transitions between Rear-Wheel
Drive (RWD) and AWD without driver intervention. Under normal driving conditions, power to the front
wheels is disengaged and 100 percent of the engine’s torque is directed to the rear wheels. When
sensors indicate more traction is needed, the system automatically engages the front wheels and
instantly transitions to AWD mode. These systems work with the vehicle’s Electronic Stability Control
(ESC)1 system to deliver precise front-to-rear torque control while preserving unrelenting drive.
